slides.title: From the map to the ground
slides.text:
01
From the map
to the ground
A simpler way to plan mining claims
and prepare the people doing the work.
Keith Ornbaum
Project overview · Development build 0.27.22
HAPPY NATIONAL GEOGRAPHY AWARENESS WEEK, NOV 16 – 20 2026

slides.title: Why ClaimField exists
slides.text:
Why ClaimField exists
02
One changed corner can mean
several things to fix.
The map
Where are the claim edges?
The crew
Which stops belong to each person?
The papers
Do the names and locations agree?

slides.title: Who ClaimField is for
slides.text:
Who ClaimField is for
03
Land reviewers
Check records and prepare
claim information.
GIS & exploration teams
Work with maps and
proposed claim shapes.
Field leaders & crews
Plan visits and bring back
what actually happened.
One prospect keeps the plan and its records together.

slides.title: The claim-staking workflow
slides.text:
04
The claim-staking workflow
1
Prospect (AOI)
Draw the area. Build the proposed grid.
2
Land Review/Search
Compare land records and review gaps.
3
Track Map
Prepare NOLs and plan the field stops.
4
County Filing
COLs and Map
Review field facts and record the papers.
5
BLM Filing
Submit the reviewed filing materials.
6
Prospect Summary
Keep the maps, records and open items.
People complete the fieldwork, verify requirements and submit the county and BLM filings.

slides.title: Land review: the map has layers
slides.text:
Land review: the map has layers
05
Like clear sheets laid
on top of one another
Terrain
What does the ground look like?
Land & survey references
Where do the records place it?
MLRS case information
What recorded cases need review?
MLRS = BLM’s Mineral & Land Records System
ClaimField can query the project area and open MLRS research tools.

slides.title: The languages behind ClaimField
Security: a key for your project notebook
slides.text:
Security: a key for your project notebook
01
Your account is the key
Sign in before opening saved projects.
02
Passwords get a one-way fingerprint
Salted scrypt hashes protect stored passwords.
03
The server checks the owner
Each saved project belongs to an account.
04
Safer document previews
Sandboxed previews block document scripts.
Your device, exported files and backups still need protection.
Verified in 0.27.18 source · Public hosting requires further security review

slides.title: What remains before wider use
slides.text:
What remains before wider use
28
1
Field proof
Run end-to-end pilots with real reviewers and crews.
2
Document checks
Confirm state and county outputs against current requirements.
3
Reliable handoffs
Test map scale, labels, ZIP contents, backups and source failures.
4
Public beta readiness
Review deployment security and resolve the reported development dependency advisory.
